name: case-file
title: Case file
for_each: select id, ref from cases where kind in ('complaint', 'grievance', 'disclosure', 'investigation', 'disciplinary', 'performance') order by ref

sections.title: The case
sections.sql: select ref, kind, title, person, raised_by, handler, country, received_on, status, decision, decision_on from v_cases where id = $1

sections.title: Allegations and findings
sections.sql: select a.n, a.category, a.text, r.name as respondent, a.finding, a.finding_on, a.finding_reasons from allegations a left join people r on r.id = a.respondent_id where a.case_id = $1 order by a.n

sections.title: Process steps
sections.note: The record a fair decision rests on: concerns put, information given, support offered, time to respond.
sections.sql: select on_date, kind, due_on, detail from steps where case_id = $1 order by on_date, created_at

sections.title: Interviews
sections.sql: select i.held_on, case when c.protected and i.role = 'discloser' then 'withheld (protected disclosure)' else coalesce(p.name, i.name) end as who, i.role, i.support_person, i.signed from interviews i join cases c on c.id = i.case_id left join people p on p.id = i.person_id where i.case_id = $1 order by i.held_on

sections.title: Evidence
sections.sql: select n, description, source, received_on, location from evidence where case_id = $1 order by n

sections.title: Gaps in the record
sections.sql: select weight, gap, source from v_fairness_gaps where case_id = $1

name: request-response
title: Statutory request: the record
for_each: select id, ref from cases where kind in ('flexible-work', 'parental-leave-extension', 'privacy-access', 'statement-of-reasons') order by ref

sections.title: The request
sections.sql: select ref, kind, title, person, country, received_on, decision, decision_on, ground_code, reasons from v_cases where id = $1

sections.title: Deadlines
sections.sql: select obligation, due_on, met_on, standing, source from v_deadline_status where case_id = $1 order by due_on

sections.title: Steps
sections.sql: select on_date, kind, detail from steps where case_id = $1 order by on_date

name: warning-record
title: Warning record
for_each: select distinct p.id, p.code from people p join warnings w on w.person_id = p.id order by p.code

sections.title: Employee
sections.sql: select code, name, job_title, team, country from people where id = $1

sections.title: Warnings
sections.sql: select ref, level, issued_on, expires_on, standing, reason, withdrawn_reason from v_warnings where person_id = $1 order by issued_on

name: monthly-report
title: Monthly HR case report
for_each: select gen_random_uuid() as id, to_char(current_date, 'YYYY-MM') as month

sections.title: Opened and decided in the last 30 days, by kind
sections.sql: select kind, count(*) filter (where received_on >= current_date - 30)::int as opened, count(*) filter (where decision_on >= current_date - 30)::int as decided, count(*) filter (where status <> 'closed')::int as open_now from cases where $1::uuid is not null group by kind order by kind

sections.title: Statutory deadlines
sections.sql: select standing, count(*)::int as obligations from v_deadline_status where $1::uuid is not null and kind in ('law', 'guidance') and due_on >= current_date - 30 group by standing order by standing

sections.title: Allegations by category, 12 months
sections.sql: select a.category, count(*)::int as allegations, count(*) filter (where a.finding in ('substantiated', 'partly-substantiated'))::int as substantiated from allegations a join cases c on c.id = a.case_id where $1::uuid is not null and c.received_on >= current_date - 365 group by a.category order by allegations desc
